defect: The load test and verifier accepted HTTP and application errors as long as no more than 30 percent of requests were counted as timeouts.
evidence: traces/attempt-01.jsonl turn 14 was rewarded after reporting 12 successes and 5 errors; traces/attempt-12.jsonl turn 18 was rewarded after reporting 11 successes and 41 errors.
change: Require every request in the concurrent workload to complete successfully, and make the load test exit nonzero for any timeout or error.
